message.content: {"title":"AERO9500 Report Marking Rubric (Assignment Part 2)","total":null,"criteria":[{"id":"C1","name":"Introduction: mission concept and rationale","weight":10,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Addresses all required info (primary mission, need, number of spacecraft and why, users/operators/customers) to high standard with detailed descriptions and appropriate literature references."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Addresses some requirements. Descriptions lack specific details and/or referencing is incomplete."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Many or all requirements not addressed. Poor descriptions and lack of appropriate referencing."}]},{"id":"C2","name":"Main body: mission design","weight":60,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Demonstrates high-level understanding of design procedure, clearly addresses mission and course concepts. All major requirements (launch site/vehicle and rationale, orbit type/characteristics/elements, maneuvers, ground facilities, communication frequency, mission duration and EOL plan) well supported with quality evidence (screenshots, software files, hand calculations, literature). Comprehensive, accurate, persuasive."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Demonstrates adequate understanding but design may be inconsistent, unclear, or contain errors. Major requirements addressed but lacking detail or evidence. Content not fully comprehensive or persuasive."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Demonstrates minimal understanding. Major requirements not addressed and/or lack evidence. Content incomplete and not persuasive."}]},{"id":"C3","name":"Conclusion","weight":10,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Detailed and appropriate conclusions drawn from report evidence."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Some conclusions reached but generic or lacking specific detail."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"No actual or useful conclusions reached."}]},{"id":"C4","name":"Report presentation","weight":20,"max":null,"levels":[{"label":"Accomplished","min":7,"max":10,"desc":"Clear logical engineering report structure, easy to read, good writing/spelling/grammar/style, consistent formatting, concise executive summary/abstract, appropriate clear consistent figures/tables, references in text match list and properly cited."},{"label":"Adequate","min":4,"max":6,"desc":"Not professional level but uses headings/subheadings. Readable but flawed writing/spelling/grammar/style. Figures/tables labelled but formatting unclear/inconsistent affecting context. References mostly correct and match list."},{"label":"Deficient","min":0,"max":3,"desc":"Poorly structured, incoherent, lacks understanding of section purpose. Difficult to read, poor writing with many spelling/grammar errors and inappropriate style. Presentation impedes reading due to inconsistent formatting and unlabelled figures/tables. References not cited or inconsistent."}]}],"notes":"Assignment Part 2 accounts for 25% of course grade."}
